// The per-tag API differences, for v0.92.1 through v0.96.3.
package storage

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/internal/core"
	"github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/internal/identity"
)

func w6AssignUserRole(c *core.KeyorixCore, ctx context.Context, actor, user, role uint, s core.Scope) error {
	return c.AssignUserRole(ctx, actor, user, role, s, false)
}

func w6AssignGroupRole(c *core.KeyorixCore, ctx context.Context, actor, group, role uint, s core.Scope) error {
	return c.AssignRoleToGroup(ctx, actor, group, role, s, false)
}

func w6AddGlobal(c *core.KeyorixCore, ctx context.Context, actor, user, group uint) error {
	return c.AddUserToGroupGlobal(ctx, actor, false, user, group)
}

func w6Rotate(c *core.KeyorixCore, ctx context.Context, id uint, val []byte, actor uint) error {
	_, err := c.RotateSecret(ctx, id, val, actor, "admin")
	return err
}

func w6Fold(name string) string {
	f, err := identity.NewFoldedName(name)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return f.Folded()
}
